_readme: Technical Product Marketing, Version 1 (checkpoint): the opening three sections of the rebuilt case study, 01 Hero, 02 Foundation and 03 Shared Product Language, then Contact. Copy is John's approved wording. The foundation library lists the real document titles and numbers from the Bolt marketing foundation in Linear (titles only; no document body is read, quoted or published). Each document carries one of the six approved category families, which sets its strip color, its faded icon and its one-line context.

hero.headline: Building the system behind the message.
hero.copy: I built the strategic foundation that turned Bolt Liquidity’s technical complexity into a clear market narrative, then carried it across documentation, web experiences, articles, and campaigns.

foundation.headline: Before the message came the foundation.
foundation.copy: Before Bolt Liquidity could be explained externally, it needed a shared internal language. I turned stakeholder interviews and product research into the positioning, claims, proof points, and narrative architecture that guided every public-facing expression.
foundation._families: The six approved pairings of category, color and faded icon. Colors are tuned for the dark surface; each strip is the full color and each icon a faded wash of it.
foundation._documents: In library order. The first entry is the source material (the six stakeholder interviews, an approved result), not one of the 16 documents; the rest are the 16 foundation documents by their Linear titles. The 00 working document and the later operating documents (16 onward) are not part of the foundation and are left out.

language._expressions: At most four, in this order. The line reaches Documentation, Articles and Campaigns on its way and comes to rest on Website, which becomes the frame of the first website visual.
